resources.string: Connect this app to your PC so it enhances video (Anime4K) and streams it over your local network.
On the PC open Tatakai › Link › Open pairing window and scan the code.
Paste the tatakai-link:v1?… text or type the 10-character code.
That is not a tatakai-link:v1 link or a 10-character code.
Camera permission is asked when you tap Scan.
Camera permission denied. Paste the code instead.
Check that the PC is on, Tatakai is open and both devices are on the same network.
This PC has no profile it can sustain in real time.
The client certificate is deleted. You will need to pair again.
The PC fetches and enhances this stream.
The PC is opening the episode where you left it
Watch something on the phone first to continue it on the PC.
Nothing is playing on the PC. Start an episode there to control it from here.
Nothing is playing on the PC
The PC sent you an episode
Looking for PCs with Tatakai open on this network…
Check that the fingerprint matches the one shown on the PC, then type the pairing code it shows.
Link this phone to Tatakai running on your Windows or Linux PC to use its extensions from here. Results from the PC appear in the source list next to your local extensions.
Use the Aniyomi, Mihon and CloudStream sources installed on your PC from this phone.
On the PC, in Tatakai\'s settings, open the extension server section, choose Link phone and scan the QR code.
Camera permission denied. You can paste the pairing link instead.
Or enter the address and password
Only if the PC has a viewer password. Otherwise pair with the QR code.
Plain http:// is only allowed for addresses on your own network: 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, 172.16–31.x.x, Tailscale (100.64.x.x), link-local and .local names. Any other address must use https://.
Away from home, use the HTTPS tunnel address shown on your PC, or Tailscale.
A pairing link opened Tatakai. Connect this phone to %1$s? Only accept links you generated on your own PC.
Scan the QR code shown on your PC to add its extensions to this phone.
Remove %1$s from this device? This phone is logged out of it; pair again to come back.
Access revoked or expired: pair again from the PC.
Your PC is not answering. Tatakai keeps using this device’s local extensions.
This pairing link is not valid.
This pairing code expired or was already used. Generate a new one on your PC.
Blocked: %1$s is not on your local network, so it must use https://.
Blocked: this address is not on your local network, so it must use https://.
Enter the server’s base address, for example http://192.168.1.20:8090 (no path).
Could not reach the server. Check that the PC is on, Tatakai is open and both devices share the network.
This PC only accepts paired devices. Scan the QR code shown on the PC.
This server uses an incompatible protocol version. Update Tatakai on the PC.
The server is not set up yet. Finish its setup on the PC first.
Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
The server could not complete the request (%1$s).
Why link your phone to your PC?
Use Aniyomi, Mihon and CloudStream sources on your phone, even though they only run on the PC.
Install and configure extensions once for every device.
The PC does the scraping and the Cloudflare bypass with its own browser.
Shared cache and progressive results: sources appear as soon as each one answers.
Less battery and CPU used on the phone.
The PC has to be on with Tatakai open.
Away from home you need the HTTPS tunnel (or Tailscale).
Video goes through the PC’s proxy, so away from home it uses the PC’s upload bandwidth.
It exposes a port on your local network.
Searching for sources has a little more latency.
Single-use QR pairing that expires in 5 minutes.
Device tokens you can revoke from the PC at any time.
If the PC does not answer, the app keeps using its local extensions.
Server mode for the Tatakai Next desktop app, optional and configurable.
